response.diary: Sun Jan 11: Positive and feeling rough, so I stayed in isolation all day, resting and doing light studying. I told my friends I'm positive; still very anxious about who I may have exposed.

messages.text: Heads up, I tested positive and have fever, cough and body aches. I'm isolating in my room. If you were near me this week, please watch for symptoms and check FlUni. Stay away from the Lucie Stern lounge.

response.thoughts: I'm positive and feel awful with fever and cough. I'm anxious and honest, so I'll stay isolated at home all day, sleep, rest, and do light studying. No lab or gym. I'll let friends know I'm positive so they can watch for symptoms, especially since Tyler and Rain were around me.
